en: First time the carrier takes damage in a battle: gain Camouflage (not targeted by ranged enemies unless blocking) for `duration` s.
"I will make you remember this lesson. I will make you forever fear the shadows."
"I will protect my teammates, and I will protect myself."
"Don't poke a hole in the bag. You don't want to get up close and personal with these little guys."
A banner representing Kazimierz knightly competition. "Just seeing it, you can almost hear the thunderous cheers."

A bridge clip that once set off a massive explosion in the night sky of Laterano.
"Fire, don't stop! Cliff, the three of us will make it big, even bigger than this!"
ATK% += atk. When dealing ARTS damage: also inflict Burn Damage (Burn elemental damage) = damage_scale * that damage.

A heavy hammer that once forged peace in the factories of Victoria, its flames now burning even brighter.
"Use the same iron and fire to end that war."
"A formula with intensified potency. It keeps you awake, provided you can stand that peculiar taste."
"You can use it to block some attacks. It doesn't mind."
"She understood when you said thank you. She's very happy she could save you."
On attack: prob chance to add 1 layer of Paralysis (each layer interrupts one enemy normal attack, max 3 layers).
"It'll have the target rolling in pain. Be sure to check the wind direction before use."
On attack: prob chance to apply Cold (ASPD -30; cold again while cold -> Frozen) for `cold` s.

"A piece of never-melting ice that once witnessed the rise and fall of the sun and moon atop the peaks of Kjerag.
"Calm yourself, like a glacier: unshakable, yet able to destroy everything.""
ATK% += atk; carrier's physical and arts damage becomes Weakness damage: each hit is dealt as whichever of physical/arts yields MORE damage against that target's DEF/RES.
"Yes, this device can help you quite a lot, but to win, you still have to rely on yourself."

On equip: destroy BOTH the item and the target operator; special refresh of refresh_cnt(2) operators of the SAME tier as the target, take choice_cnt(1) free. Multiplayer: at next prep phase send 1 copy of the original operator to the teammate who has the most operators of that operator's bond(s) (tie -> random). Cannot target DIY (custom) operators. Never merges.
"This is a gift. You can turn it into anything you want."

Normal: equip onto any normal operator (occupies a slot until next round start), at the start of the next round destroy item and promote the operator to elite (Elite/golden). Golden: on equip, destroy item and promote immediately. On promotion, equipped items return to hand.
"Raise your glass, mind the curve of your smile, and I guarantee you'll be a smash hit! No, that's not moving enough yet. Go try on another outfit."

On taking effect, the original Operator is destroyed, and the Mutant Cell and other Equipment return to the Bench and can be equipped again; then gain a random starting Operator one tier higher (up to Tier 6), placed on the Bench and needing to be redeployed
maxHP% += max_hp. If carrier also holds Pegasus Lance (either quality): regen hp_recovery_per_sec_by_max_hp_ratio * maxHP per second.

ATK% += atk. If carrier also holds Pegasus Helm: every damage instance additionally deals atk_scale * ATK as TRUE damage [ASSUMED: % of ATK, per blackboard key atk_scale; description says 30% true damage].

ATK% += atk. If carrier has bond Laterano: on each attack, prob chance to fire an extra bullet at 1 enemy in range dealing atk_scale_1 * ATK physical damage; if carrier also holds Laterano Bridge Clip -> atk_scale_2 * ATK.
"The people of Laterano have never doubted the majesty of the Gun Knights."

maxHP% += max_hp. If carrier has bond Yan: at battle start ASPD += attack_speed * min(k, max_cnt), k = operators the player acquired during THIS round's prep. If also holding Yan Short Blade: each time the player acquires an operator, funds += count (max `max` times per round).
"The people of Yan believe the ancient legends of the Celestial Masters are by no means pure fiction."

Drag onto the field during prep: opens a personal bounty choice (choice event hunter_band_1). The chosen bounty adds extra enemies to your next battle; killing them / perfect defence grants funds (see ENEMY_GAIN '...Bounty' effects). Consumed.

Flat damage reduction: each incoming hit reduced by `value` (180/300, min 0 [ASSUMED]). If carrier has bond Aegir: when taking damage, deal atk_scale * ATK arts damage to the source (internal CD lock_duration 0.5 s); if also holding Aegir Greatblade, one additional hit of atk_scale * ATK arts (same CD).
"The secrets of the Aegirians are buried in the deepest ocean trenches, but they have never truly died."

ASPD += attack_speed_1 (35/55). If carrier has bond Victoria: gains the special effects of every hammer (Burn/Sturdy/Haste/Tremble) currently equipped by ANY of the player's on-field operators (burn 10% of arts dmg, undying 8 s, ASPD +30, 10% tremble 2 s). If it also holds a hammer-series item, that hammer's special effect is doubled (burn 20%, undying 16 s, ASPD +60, tremble prob 20% [ASSUMED doubling targets]).
"The Victorians have proven over many eras that truth lies within steam and gears."

RES += magic_resistance. If carrier has bond Kjerag: every `interval` (1 s) each Cold or Frozen enemy inside the carrier's attack range takes atk_scale * ATK arts damage; atk_scale_ex (100%) if carrier also holds Kjerag Unmelting Ice.
"The people of Kjerag believe the gems in the deepest part of the glaciers are the tears of Enciodes."

Initial SP += init_sp (30/50). If carrier has bond Sargon: when its FIRST skill ends, SP += sp (30). If also holding Sargon Strong Tea: each time the carrier activates a skill, all Sargon operators on field gain addition_sp (3) SP.
"Legend has it that the people of Sargon will find the mark of time's reversal at the end of the yellow sands."
"This new guy can definitely help out, right?"
"Mutant Cluster, we've already seen what you're capable of..."

respawnTime *= (1 + respawn_time) (-40%/-60%). If carrier has bond Kazimierz: for `duration` (20) s after activating a skill, enemies inside its attack range get ASPD x attack_speed(0.65) and move speed x move_speed(0.65) (i.e. -35%). If also holding Kazimierz Tournament Banner: during skill duration ATK% += atk (+100%), and lethal damage does not retreat it; it retreats when the skill ends.
A code of conduct set down for the knights of Kazimierz. "Honest, steadfast, brave, unyielding."

spRecoveryPerSec += sp_recovery_per_sec (0.2/0.35). If carrier has bond Siracusa: while Camouflaged, ATK% += atk_per_sec per second (2%/s) up to max_atk (+100%, i.e. 200% ATK); the bonus lasts until the first damage dealt after camouflage ends, or until the carrier leaves the field. If also holding Siracusan Formal Wear: that first hit after losing camouflage additionally deals atk_scale (800%) * ATK true damage.
A Siracusan badge that can make one a "family member". "Learn to stay by your family. Your real family."
Periodically inflicts <$ba.cold>Cold</> on all enemies on the field for a certain duration
